name: Dr. Pragya Jain
bio:
With over 12+ years of experience in dentistry, Dr. Pragya Jain is committed to delivering professional, compassionate, and high-quality dental care. Combining advanced dental techniques with a patient-centered approach, Dr. Jain focuses on creating healthy, confident smiles in a comfortable and friendly environment.
Known for professionalism, precision, and personalized treatment planning, Dr. Jain believes in providing ethical and modern dental solutions tailored to each patient’s needs. The clinic is dedicated to ensuring every patient receives exceptional care, comfort, and long-lasting dental health.
